newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-BENN IN COURT ON ASSAULT CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-BENN IN COURT ON ASSAULT CHARGE.

text.p: Britain's former world boxing champion Nigel Benn appeared in court on Friday to face charges related to an incident in a London nightclub two months ago.
Benn, 32, whose ring nickname was The Dark Destroyer, was released on bail of 50,000 pounds ($83,000) on charges of grievous bodily harm following the incident on September 29.
Police charged the former super-middleweight boxer on Thursday. He is due to reappear before a London court on December 27.
Benn announced his second retirement from boxing at the weekend after a defeat by Irishman Steve Collins.
